row: Canberra Chiropractor Dr. Murray Fisher opened up his Canberra practice more than 25 years ago and hasn't looked back since! He aims to provide a chiropractic centre where every member of the Canberra community can receive chiropractic care as a pathway to achieving optimum health. Murray Fisher remains passionate about providing the best in chiropractic care characterised by a high level of technical expertise delivered in a caring and professional manner.
